_comment: Battle of the Realm — the one-shot SFX catalogue. Shared source of truth for
tools/generate-sfx.js (which buys them) and tools/trim-sfx.sh (which cuts them).
Every name here is a cue the game already triggers — see the `S` table in
scripts/battle/util.js. Generating one upgrades every call site at once; a cue
you never generate simply keeps its built-in WebAudio synth voice.
`cap` is the trimmed ceiling in seconds. These fire fast and often and several
can overlap, so anything that reads as an impact stays short. Edit a prompt and
re-run with --force to buy a new take.

hit.prompt: Cartoon battle impact — a solid meaty thwack with a short low thud underneath, storybook creature duel, punchy and satisfying, completely dry, no reverb tail

splash.prompt: A creature belly-flopping into water — a big cartoon splash with a quick watery gulp and light droplet patter, playful not harsh, short tail

good.prompt: Bright cheerful success blip — a crisp two-note ascending chime, small win confirmation, warm and encouraging, very short and dry

bad.prompt: Gentle cartoon mistake sound — a soft descending two-note wobble, disappointed but kind, never harsh or buzzy, short and dry

star.prompt: Sparkling star pickup — a bright glassy twinkle rising with a light magical shimmer, collectible reward, clean and short, no tail

pickup.prompt: Tiny bright collect pop — a quick glassy blip catching something, clean arcade pickup, very short, no reverb

combo.prompt: Combo streak ding — an exciting bright digital chime a step higher than the last, rewarding escalation, crisp and very short

tick.prompt: Short dry countdown tick — a clean wooden clock blip, neutral and crisp, tiny, absolutely no tail

go.prompt: FIGHT! countdown release — a bright rising horn-and-chime stab that launches the round, energetic and heroic, punchy, short tail

swipe.prompt: Fast cartoon whoosh — a light airy swish of a creature darting past, soft and clean, short, no reverb

ui.prompt: Crisp UI confirm tap — a light wooden mallet click with a soft warm tone, storybook menu button press, snappy and dry, tiny

win.prompt: Short victory jingle — a triumphant ascending major-key flourish with bells and a bright sparkle, a duel won, celebratory, resolves cleanly

lose.prompt: Gentle defeat jingle — a soft descending minor-key phrase, wistful and kind rather than punishing, encourages another try, resolves and ends

fanfare.prompt: Regal royal fanfare announcing an evil king — bold brass fanfare with a dark ominous undertow and a deep timpani hit, storybook villain arrival, dramatic

badge.prompt: Achievement unlocked chime — a warm rising bell arpeggio finishing on a bright sparkle, proud and rewarding, clean and short
